description: Publish a public web page without an account or API key. It expires in 48 hours. Returns the page URL and a personal claimUrl; opening that link while signed in makes the page permanent.

files.description: Files of the page. The complete resulting page includes index.html at the top level.

content.description: File contents: text, or base64 when encoding is base64.

encoding.description: utf8 (default) for text files, base64 for images and other binary files.

path.description: Path inside the page, e.g. index.html or assets/logo.png.

siteName.description: Name shown to the user and recipients, e.g. "Q3 report".

slug.description: Optional address label, 3-40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Random when omitted.

name: publish_anonymous_page

claimUrl.description: Show to the user: opening it while signed in keeps the page.

expiresAt.description: When the page expires (ms since epoch).

title: Publish anonymous page
